description: Destructive, but safe by default: previews the impact unless dryRun is false, requires confirm: true to delete, and archives the ADR so syncytium_restore can undo it.

confirm.description: Must be true with dryRun:false to actually delete.

dryRun.description: Preview the impact without changing anything (default).

id.description: ADR id to remove, e.g. ADR-003

name: syncytium_remove_decision
